description: Eventi-emergenze-Protezione Civile (WMS) is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by servizigis.regione.emilia-romagna.it. WMS of part of emergency management and reconstruction support data (since 2024. Note: there is a similar WMS for the events in May 2023). Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Events-Emergencies-Civil Protection (WMS)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
